name: weld_bead_goes_between_touching_faces
why: ENTRY Z-C6. `weld_bead` was in the catalogue with `Provata = true` and **has never created a bead**: it passed to `InsertCosmeticWeldBead2` all the faces of two sets of bodies, and that call returns null in every combination tried on 25/9/2026. The bead is born only with the old call, by selection, and with ONE face per side. From library 0.114.0 the operation takes two faces.
defect_caught: The bead between faces that do not touch. SOLIDWORKS creates it just the same — measured: it is born, and the side read back from the feature is 40 instead of the 4 asked — and a weld that does not exist would end up in the BOM. Step 4 demands it refused. Step 5 takes the other easy mistake: the HEAD of the short bar resting on the long one does really touch, but it is a face-against-face contact, and a fillet bead there makes no sense.
_and_the_twins_are_in_the_same_file: The good bead (step 6) goes from the side face of the short one to the top face of the long one. Step 4 changes only the destination face (the back one of the long one, at 80 mm); step 5 changes only the starting one (the head of the short one).
_the_selectors_are_measured: The two bars have faces that are equal in pairs — the outer and the inner one of the tube have the same direction and the same area — and `n=` chooses by order in the state. Measured on 25/9/2026 after the cut: the long one has faces of 40800 mm2 (600 x 68), the short one of 17680 (260 x 68); between the two «front» faces of the long one the outer one (z = 40) is the second, between the two «right» faces of the short one the outer one (x = 340) is the first, between the two «back» faces of the long one the outer one (z = -40) is the first. The cut head of the short one is the only face of 1469.96 mm2 with the direction «back».

expect.tolerance_why: 40 mm x 1469.956 mm2 of section, which has pi inside (the corner radii). Without the cut the short one would stay inside the long one and there would be no common edge to rest the bead on

the common edge is the FLAT side of the tube: 80 minus two radii of 6. Counted on the geometry, to the hundredth; a bead 80 long would mean that the arcs of the corners were counted too, which do not rest on the top face
read back from the definition of the feature: it is the measure that between distant faces came out as 40. The thousandth is the rounding of the metre-to-millimetre conversion
the bead is COSMETIC: the volume is that of the cut T (1322960.17 minus 58798.23), and if it changed it would mean material was added
